Name: Runic Ring - Socketable Magic Runes and Active Abilities
Author: s1lence17
Description:
[size=5][b]Runic Ring — Socketable Magic Runes[/b][/size]

Bring lightweight, vanilla-friendly RPG magic to Stardew Valley! [b]Runic Ring[/b] introduces an ancient ring with an empty socket and [b]9 unique elemental runes[/b]. Socket runes directly in your inventory to gain passive stat bonuses and unleash active abilities using Stamina.

[size=4][b]✨ Key Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Interactive Socketing System:[/b] Pick up any rune in your inventory and [b]Right-Click[/b] on a Runic Ring to socket it. Right-click an empty hand on the ring to extract the rune at any time![/*]
[*][b]Dual Ring Casting:[/b] Equip two Runic Rings at once! Use [b]R[/b] to cast the ability of your Left Ring and [b]F[/b] for your Right Ring — each with its own independent cooldown.[/*]
[*][b]Visual Socket Indicators:[/b] Socketed rings display a mini-icon of the active rune in the corner of the slot and a custom tooltip window when hovered.[/*]
[*][b]Balanced Stamina Costs:[/b] Abilities consume player energy (Stamina) and feature lore-friendly descriptions so you can discover their full potential naturally.[/*]
[*][b]Full GMCM Support & Localization:[/b] Customize keybinds, cooldowns, drop rates, and visual badges via Generic Mod Config Menu. Built-in support for [b]English, Russian, and Ukrainian[/b]![/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]🔮 The 9 Runes & How to Obtain Them[/b][/size]
Runes are unlocked immediately in your Crafting Menu or discovered through exploration:
[list]
[*][b]Wind Rune (Craftable):[/b] Increases movement speed and lets you dash forward through obstacles.[/*]
[*][b]Life Rune (Craftable):[/b] Slowly regenerates health over time and casts an instant healing wave.[/*]
[*][b]Fire Rune (Craftable):[/b] Boosts attack damage and unleashes a fiery blast that knocks back nearby monsters.[/*]
[*][b]Lightning Rune (Craftable):[/b] Increases critical strike chance and calls down a high-damage lightning bolt on the nearest foe.[/*]
[*][b]Void Rune (Craftable):[/b] Grants bonus defense and drains life force from surrounding enemies to heal you.[/*]
[*][b]Earth Rune (Mine Drop - Floor 80+):[/b] Increases magnetic radius and shatters nearby rocks, twigs, and weeds for bonus resources.[/*]
[*][b]Frost Rune (Mine Drop - Floor 80+):[/b] Increases defense and casts an icy nova that damages and slows monsters.[/*]
[*][b]Sea Rune (Fishing Treasure Chests):[/b] Purely passive rune that boosts Fishing skill and increases the chance of finding treasure chests while fishing.[/*]
[*][b]Luck Rune (Mystery Boxes):[/b] Passively increases Luck and grants a temporary burst of Fortune and Speed when activated.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]⚙️ Requirements & Installation[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Requires [b]SMAPI 4.0+[/b] (Stardew Valley 1.6).[/*]
[*][i](Optional)[/i] [b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b] for easy in-game configuration.[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] directory.[/*]
[/list]
